title: Verordnung zur Änderung der Aufenthaltsverordnung und der AZRG-Durchführungsverordnung vom 18. Dezember 2015 (BGBl. 2015 I Nr. 54, S. 2467 bis 2477), full gazette text
in_force: Art. 1 No. 10 in force the day after promulgation (Art. 3(3)): promulgated 28 Dec 2015, so 29 Dec 2015
verified_how: curl was answered with an HTML shell that needs JavaScript (no PDF). The document was opened in a Chrome session that the repository owner (Meng Wong) directed Claude to drive, and the PDF was saved from the archive viewer's download icon: by the owner's own click on 2026-11-02 (the file deposited here) and, earlier the same day, by two attempts of Claude's whose copies had identical extracted text. Commons guide §8 treats a bot challenge as a 'no'; the owner agreed to the browser read, and whether that is acceptable under the guide is for Michael to say. Text extracted with pdftotext -layout. notes: German is the only authoritative language; any English in the encoding is a gloss.
